# Awake

> Awake is a tiny native macOS menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake. Turn it on, turn it off, set a sunset, or stay awake while an app is running. Start at login, show a countdown in the menu bar, and adjust settings for a shortcut, display sleep, and battery. Requires macOS 13 or later.

Awake is an independent app built by Dawid Woźniak and Sature. It keeps your Mac awake on the machine and does not collect or send user data.

## What it does

- On: keep the Mac awake until you turn it off
- Off: return to normal sleep
- Sunset: a timer that ends the session, up to 10 hours
- End at: a time of day, in 15-minute steps. A time already past ends the next day
- Until: stay awake while a chosen app is running, then return to Off
- Start at login
- Optional countdown in the menu bar
- Shortcut: switch between Off and the last On, Sunset, or Until
- Allow display sleep: the display can sleep while the Mac stays awake
- Turn off on battery: Awake turns off on battery and stays off when power returns
- Settings: Theme 1, 2 and 3, with highlight colors White, Green, Purple and Blue. Check for Updates is in this window
